challenge.title: Book a Trip and Handle a Problem
challenge.instructions: Write and say a short Moroccan Arabic conversation of at least 10 lines. Book a hotel room or a ticket, ask the price or the time, describe a problem that happens while travelling (a delay, a lost bag or a missed bus), and ask for help. End with a polite wish.
required_elements: A request to book a room or a ticket using بغيت نحجز or بغيت بيت
A question about the price or the time using شحال or فأي ساعة
A problem described using ضاعت ليا, فاتني, تعطلات or كاين مشكل
A request for help using عافاك
A polite closing wish such as الله يعوض or الله يعطيك الصحة

dialogue.transliteration: salaamu 3alaykum, bghit n7ejz biyyi dyal l-kaar l-mrraksh
dialogue.english: Peace be upon you, I want to book a bus ticket to Marrakech.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.arabic: وعليكم السلام، الذهاب والإياب ولا غير الذهاب؟
dialogue.transliteration: w 3alaykum s-salaam, dh-dhhaab w l-iyaab wla ghir dh-dhhaab?
dialogue.english: And upon you peace, round trip or one way only?

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.arabic: الذهاب والإياب، شحال التمن؟
dialogue.transliteration: dh-dhhaab w l-iyaab, shhaal t-taman?
dialogue.english: Round trip, how much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.arabic: مية وخمسين درهم، والكار كيمشي فالتسعة
dialogue.transliteration: miyya w khamsiin dirham, w l-kaar kaymshi f-t-tes3a
dialogue.english: A hundred and fifty dirhams, and the bus leaves at nine.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.arabic: شكرا، واش نقدر نخلص بالكارط؟
dialogue.transliteration: shukran, waash nqder nkhlleS b-l-kaarT?
dialogue.english: Thanks, can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.arabic: لَا، غِير كَاش، عَافَاك
dialogue.transliteration: laa, ghir kaash, 3afak
dialogue.english: No, cash only, please.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.arabic: مزيان، هاك. للأسف فاتني الكار الأول، واش كاين واحد تاني؟
dialogue.transliteration: mezyaan, haak. l-lasaf faatni l-kaar l-lawwal, waash kayn wa7ed taani?
dialogue.english: Fine, here you go. Unfortunately I missed the first bus, is there another one?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.arabic: ما تقلقش، كاين واحد من بعد ساعة
dialogue.transliteration: ma tqlaqsh, kayn wa7ed mn b3d saa3a
dialogue.english: Don't worry, there's one in an hour.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.arabic: الله يعوض، الله يعطيك الصحة
dialogue.transliteration: allah y3awwed, allah y3Tiik S-Sa7a
dialogue.english: May God make up for it, God give you health.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.arabic: اللَّهُ يْبَارِك فِيك، مَرْحَبَا بِيك
dialogue.transliteration: allah ybaarek fik, mer7ba bik
dialogue.english: God bless you, you're welcome.
